label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
Some genuinely good news to share first: Priya Bhatia is joining us on Monday 16 November. Priya is a chartered structural engineer (IStructE) and has spent nine years at a consultancy in Coventry. I’m very pleased to have her on board — and if you see her on site, please do say hello and make her feel welcome.

Her arrival also means we can properly tackle our turnaround times. In September and October, beam calculations and drawings were taking 5–6 weeks. That was too slow. Our target now is **10 working days**.

I don’t want to announce that as though the last two months didn’t happen. Several clients waited far too long, some were understandably unhappy, and one left a sharp review. One couple in Harborne had their builder waiting with the steel already ordered; we got the calculations to them within three days, but only after they had chased us twice. That shouldn’t have been necessary.

The delays were my fault. I said yes to too much work while trying to do everything on my own. In October I was doing site visits during the day and calculations until midnight; my wife started calling the office “the other house”. None of that is an excuse for keeping people waiting.

If your job is still with us, please know it is moving. You can message me directly and I’ll update you.

One other change: our free first site visit is ending. For first visits taking place **on or after 1 January 2027**, there will be a **£95 charge**, which will be deducted from our fee if you go ahead. **If your visit is already booked when this post is published, it stays free, whatever date it’s booked for.**

The free visits were a lovely way to meet people, but around a third never became a job, and that time has to come from somewhere.

I’m genuinely excited about Priya joining us and about giving clients a quicker, more reliable service again. Thank you to everyone who has been patient with us — and to those who chased when they needed to.
